caption: The drawing depicts a metallic teapot positioned at the center of the composition, shown in a three-quarter view. The teapot has a wide, cylindrical body with a slightly domed and decorated lid. A finial sits atop the lid, featuring a leaf-like design. Extending from the left side of the teapot is a long, narrow spout, sharply angled upward. On the right side, there is an arched handle that appears darker in shading compared to the rest of the object. The teapot rests on a flat rectangular surface which is also shaded, providing the base for the overall composition. The drawing is executed in pencil, with shades of grey and graphite used throughout to create the appearance of light and shadow on the metallic surface, giving elicit reflections and highlights. The background remains plain and unshaded, and there is a signature in the lower right corner reading "G. Capelli."
title: Silver Teapot
